label: VERIFIED
extraction: Local-First AI Agents: Hybrid Cloud-Edge Architectures (Zylos Research). 2025 dominant architecture: send every inference to frontier cloud model. 2026 shift to hybrid driven by: privacy regulations (EU AI Act effective Aug 2 2026, strict data residency), cost pressure (1000 tasks/day × 8 LLM calls × 2000 tokens = 16M tokens/day ≈ $150-300/day at Claude Sonnet 4 pricing), latency (quantized 7B on RTX 4090: 300+ tokens/sec, sub-ms latency vs cloud round-trip). Local-first is design philosophy producing better agents: faster, cheaper, more private, more available. For platform builders, local-first not a compromise but superior architecture.
